name: ZS public destory_pair_amount burns accumulated sells from the pair
summary: ZS adds every sell amount to Burnamount and lets anyone call destory_pair_amount(), which burns Burnamount from the ZS/USDT pair's balance and syncs it. With a flash-loaned 16.3M USDT the attacker bought all but Burnamount of the pair's ZS, called destory_pair_amount to burn the rest, and sold the ZS back into a pair holding almost none for its USDT.
notes: The anchor is the drain; the referenced contract creation two blocks earlier only bought 90,520 ZS for 10.56 USDT and sold 1 ZS from the constructor to register a daily sell snapshot, moving no victim funds. Its 10.56 USDT round trip is subtracted from the pair's 22,185.79 USDT net outflow (rule 11); the 8,170 USDT flash fee is not. No other call of destory_pair_amount appears in the token's history.
